title: TreeRL: LLM Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Tree Search
authors_zh: Zhenyu Hou, Ziniu Hu, Yujiang Li, Rui Lu, Jie Tang, Yuxiao Dong
paper_type_zh: 基于熵引导树搜索的 on-policy 强化学习与过程监督配方
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理搜索轨迹、过程奖励、终点 verifier 与训练预算归因的读者
one_line: TreeRL uses entropy-guided on-policy search trees to turn terminal correctness into reweighted step-level rewards; the public repository releases input prompts and code, not a verified corpus of the resulting runtime trees.
TreeRL 将熵引导的 on-policy 搜索树中叶节点的终点正确性转化为重加权逐步奖励；公开仓库发布了输入提示与代码，但未核验发布运行时树语料。
why: For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, TreeRL shows that a trace-data contract includes search topology, budget, terminal checking, and selection—not merely a final answer—and that missing raw trees block full audit.
inclusion_reason: TreeRL is an on-policy search-to-process-supervision recipe: it makes branch provenance, terminal checking, search budget, and credit assignment part of a reasoning-trace data contract, while exposing the absence of released runtime trees and self-contained verifier artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Conventional on-policy reasoning RL commonly samples independent completions and gives only an outcome reward. TreeRL asks whether the same on-policy search episode can both explore more alternatives and provide intermediate credit without separately training a process reward model. Its relevant object is therefore not one selected answer: it is a prompt-indexed EPTree containing initial chains, selected fork positions, branch continuations, leaf outcomes, descendant-derived values, and step rewards.

This belongs to Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because the outcome depends on a set of sampled paths, their shared prefixes, terminal checking, and a generation-token budget. It is not a released trace dataset: the official repository exposes a prompt-answer JSONL input file and code, while raw EPTrees, rejected branches, node-level rewards, and leaf-to-training-trace selection records were not verified as public artifacts.

The paper was accepted as an ACL 2025 long paper. The Card reaches L4 after checking the ACL record and full paper, arXiv full text, official THUDM repository, license, launcher, EPTree code, and remote-reward implementation. This is evidence for the recipe and artifact boundary, not for the quality of unreleased runtime traces.

传统的推理 on-policy RL 往往独立采样多个完整回答，只给出终点奖励。TreeRL 要解决的问题是：能否让同一次 on-policy 搜索既探索更多候选路径，又在不单独训练过程奖励模型的前提下提供中间归因。因此，它的关键对象不是一条入选答案，而是按提示组织的 EPTree：初始链、入选分叉位置、分支续写、叶节点结果、由后代推导的价值和逐步奖励。

它属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为结果依赖一组采样路径、共享前缀、终点检查和生成 token 预算。它并不是已发布的轨迹数据集：官方仓库公开的是提示—答案 JSONL 输入文件与代码；原始 EPTree、被拒绝分支、节点级奖励以及从叶节点到训练 trace 的选择记录尚未核验为公开工件。

论文为 ACL 2025 长文。本卡在核验 ACL 记录和全文、arXiv 全文、THUDM 官方仓库、许可证、launcher、EPTree 代码及远程奖励实现后达到 L4。这些证据支持配方及其工件边界，并不证明未发布运行时轨迹的质量。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
EPTree starts with M complete response chains. It ranks eligible token positions by uncertainty, selects the top N positions, continues T branches from each, and repeats for L expansion rounds. In the main reported setting, (M,N,L,T)=(6,2,1,2), which produces 30 leaves per prompt.

The feedback contract is terminally anchored. A completed leaf is assigned binary final-answer correctness. For each tree node, TreeRL estimates value as the fraction of correct descendant leaves; it then combines a global advantage relative to the virtual root with a local advantage relative to the parent. Because shared non-leaf segments occur in multiple extracted sequences, their update values are divided by the square root of selected descendant traces.

Relative to independent ChainRL sampling, this changes the sample topology and the supervision granularity together. Relative to a static PRM, the process signal is regenerated from the current policy's tree. It does not make terminal correctness a proof of every intermediate step, nor does the public release expose a static corpus that would permit an independent check of those derived signals.

EPTree 先生成 M 条完整回答链，再按不确定性对可用 token 位置排序，选取前 N 个位置，并从每个位置续写 T 个分支，重复 L 轮扩展。论文的主设定为 (M,N,L,T)=(6,2,1,2)，每个提示得到 30 个叶节点。

其反馈契约以终点为锚：完成的叶节点获得二值最终答案正确性。对每个树节点，TreeRL 用正确后代叶节点所占比例估计价值；随后把相对虚拟根节点的全局 advantage 与相对父节点的局部 advantage 结合。共享的非叶片段会出现在多条抽取序列中，因此其更新值再除以入选后代 trace 数的平方根。

与独立采样的 ChainRL 相比，它同时改变了样本拓扑与监督粒度；与静态 PRM 相比，过程信号由当前策略生成的树重新计算。它不会使终点正确性成为每一步都有效的证明，公开发布也没有提供可供独立检查这些派生信号的静态树语料。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and initialization. The paper reports sampling RL prompts from public MATH-train and NuminaMath. The checked launcher reads datasets/train/train_30k.jsonl, using text, label, and data_type; it is not accompanied by a row-level mapping to the paper-named sources. The policy generates M complete initial chains for each prompt.

Search and feedback. EPTree masks near-end positions, ranks eligible tokens by negative log probability as its uncertainty measure, forks continuations from selected positions, and forms leaves. The paper assigns each leaf final-answer reward 1 or 0. Descendant correctness becomes a node value, then global plus local advantages; repeated non-leaf updates receive square-root reweighting. The launcher invokes private extractor and binary-judge services, so the deployed answer-normalization and equivalence behavior are unknown.

Training settings. The reported RL configuration uses 16 prompts per update, temperature 1.2, top-p 0.95, maximum length 8192, learning rate 1.5e-6, and KL coefficient 1e-4. It compares 30 EPTree leaves with 16 independent responses at similar generation-token budget, but reports a TreeRL training batch of 480 versus 256 for ChainRL; equal inference cost does not imply equal training computation. The checked launcher agrees on model family, leaf-setting parameters, temperature, top-p, maximum length, and learning rate, but sets KL=0.0 and NUM_TRACE=16. A paper-matched command, service deployment, raw-tree serializer, and checkpoint were not verified.

输入与初始化。 论文称从公开的 MATH-train 和 NuminaMath 中抽取 RL 提示。已核验 launcher 读取 datasets/train/train_30k.jsonl，使用 text、label 和 data_type；但没有随附逐行映射，将其连接到论文点名的两个来源。策略会为每个提示生成 M 条完整初始链。

搜索与反馈。 EPTree 会屏蔽接近结尾的位置，以负对数概率作为不确定性度量给可用 token 排序，从入选位置继续生成分支，并形成叶节点。论文给每个叶节点赋予 1 或 0 的最终答案奖励；后代正确性成为节点价值，再形成全局加局部 advantage；重复的非叶更新采用平方根重加权。launcher 调用私有 extractor 与 binary judge 服务，因此已部署的答案规范化和等价判断行为为 unknown。

训练设置。 论文报告每次更新使用 16 个提示、温度 1.2、top-p 0.95、最大长度 8192、学习率 1.5e-6、KL 系数 1e-4。它在相近生成 token 预算下比较 30 个 EPTree 叶节点与 16 个独立回答，但报告 TreeRL 的训练 batch 为 480、ChainRL 为 256；相同推理成本不等于相同训练计算量。已核验 launcher 在模型家族、叶节点参数、温度、top-p、最大长度和学习率上相符，但设置 KL=0.0 且 NUM_TRACE=16。论文匹配的完整命令、服务部署、原始树序列化器和 checkpoint 均未核验。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The evidence should be read as system-level method evidence, not data-quality validation.

  • Search comparison. On Omni-MATH-500, Appendix Table 4 reports the selected (6,2,1,2) EPTree setting at 30 leaves, 56.9 PassRate, and 22,268 generation tokens; multi-16 reports 16 leaves, 52.4 PassRate, and 19,858 tokens. Table 2 also reports entropy forking at 56.9 PassRate and 22,268 tokens, random forking at 54.8 and 24,213, and multi-chain at 52.4 and 19,858. These are compared-budget search results, not measurements of trace-label precision.
  • RL evaluation. Table 1 reports average greedy-evaluation accuracy of 44.5 for TreeRL versus 41.6 for ChainRL for the Qwen-2.5-14B line; 29.3 versus 27.2 for GLM4-9B; and 65.8 versus 64.5 for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-2.5-7B. The six reported benchmarks are MATH500, Omni-MATH-500, AIME2024, AMC, OlympiadBench, and LiveCodeBench. The authors also state that both RL methods show only minor improvement over the SFT baseline in that setting.
  • Ablation boundary. The paper reports that combined global and local advantages with square-root reweighting performs best among its tested process-signal designs, and that using a subset of sampled responses gives less improvement. This does not isolate the effects of search topology, more leaves, more optimization traces, and process credit.
  • Artifact evidence. The official repository is public and Apache-2.0 licensed. It contains the named 10,562,582-byte input JSONL, launcher, EPTree implementation, and remote-reward code; no raw EPTree release or TreeRL checkpoint was verified. Thus performance results do not establish that the public input file or unshared runtime trees are high quality.

这些证据应被理解为系统层面的配方证据，而非数据质量验证。

  • 搜索比较。 在 Omni-MATH-500 上，附录表 4 报告入选的 (6,2,1,2) EPTree 设定为 30 个叶节点、56.9 PassRate、22,268 个生成 token；multi-16 为 16 个叶节点、52.4 PassRate、19,858 个 token。表 2 还报告熵分叉为 56.9 PassRate 和 22,268 token，随机分叉为 54.8 和 24,213，multi-chain 为 52.4 和 19,858。这是预算可比的搜索结果，不是轨迹标签精度的测量。
  • RL 评测。 表 1 报告 Qwen-2.5-14B 线的贪婪评测平均准确率：TreeRL 为 44.5，ChainRL 为 41.6；GLM4-9B 为 29.3 对 27.2；DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-2.5-7B 为 65.8 对 64.5。六个报告基准为 MATH500、Omni-MATH-500、AIME2024、AMC、OlympiadBench 和 LiveCodeBench。作者也指出，在该设定下两种 RL 方法相对 SFT 基线的提升都较小。
  • 消融边界。 论文报告，在已测试的过程信号设计中，结合全局与局部 advantage 并做平方根重加权的表现最好；只使用一部分采样回答的提升较小。但这不能分离搜索拓扑、更多叶节点、更多优化 trace 与过程归因各自的影响。
  • 工件证据。 官方仓库公开并采用 Apache-2.0 许可证。它包含所述 10,562,582 字节输入 JSONL、launcher、EPTree 实现和远程奖励代码；未核验到原始 EPTree 发布或 TreeRL checkpoint。因此，性能结果不能证明公开输入文件或未共享运行时树具有高质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline in the paper is ChainRL: independent on-policy multi-response sampling with final-answer feedback. TreeRL changes two coupled interfaces. First, EPTree branches from policy-uncertain intermediate tokens instead of making all samples independent or applying conventional stepwise MCTS. Second, terminal outcomes from that current-policy tree become per-step credit through descendant values and global/local advantages.

This differs from offline tree-search data construction and static PRM use because the tree and its signal are regenerated on policy during RL. It does not introduce final-answer checking, policy gradients, tree search, or advantage estimation individually. Its direction signal for this track is the explicit trace contract: branch location, shared prefixes, leaf outcome, budget, and reweighting affect what supervision a trajectory contains.

Before reuse, compare against an independent-sampling RLVR baseline at matched generation and optimization budgets, retain all branches rather than only selected traces, and verify terminal services. The paper's performance gains alone do not identify which component transfers or whether the derived process labels are reliable.

论文中最接近的基线是 ChainRL：独立的 on-policy 多回答采样加最终答案反馈。TreeRL 改变了两个相互耦合的接口。第一，EPTree 从策略不确定的中间 token 分叉，而非让所有样本独立，或采用传统逐步 MCTS。第二，当前策略树的终点结果经由后代价值和全局/局部 advantage 变成逐步归因。

这不同于离线树搜索数据构造和静态 PRM 的使用，因为树及其信号会在 RL 期间随策略重新生成。它并未分别首创最终答案检查、策略梯度、树搜索或 advantage 估计。对本分类而言，其方向信号是明确的 trace 契约：分叉位置、共享前缀、叶节点结果、预算和重加权都会改变一条轨迹所携带的监督。

复用前，应在匹配生成与优化预算下与独立采样 RLVR 基线比较，保留全部分支而非仅保留入选 trace，并核验终点服务。论文的性能增益本身无法确定哪一部分可迁移，也无法证明派生过程标签可靠。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Terminal-only anchoring. A correct final answer can coexist with invalid, irrelevant, or copied intermediate reasoning. Tree-derived rewards estimate success frequency under this policy and finite search budget; they are not an independent verifier of semantic step validity. This is a curator inference from the stated feedback contract.

Unreleased verifier and trace boundary. The checked launcher requires private extractor and binary-judge endpoints. Their models, prompts, versions, retry behavior, and calibration are unknown. Although code can represent parent links, tokens, scores, and terminal data, no public raw-tree, rejected-branch, or leaf-to-training-trace record was verified; reconstruction and audit cannot recover them from prompt-answer rows.

Budget and attribution. The paper states that EPTree needs at least two generation rounds and is approximately twice as slow as multi-chain sampling without dedicated tree inference optimization. Its selected setup uses 30 leaves and a 480 training batch versus 16 and 256 for ChainRL. Matched generation-token comparisons therefore do not isolate the effect of the process reward from extra search paths or optimizer computation.

Data governance. The paper names MATH-train and NuminaMath but does not provide a release manifest, source proportions, decontamination analysis, benchmark-overlap analysis, row-level splits, or upstream-rights mapping for the input JSONL. Code Apache-2.0 does not resolve dataset or generated-trace reuse rights.

终点锚定的局限。 最终答案正确可以与无效、不相关或复制的中间推理同时出现。树派生奖励估计的是该策略和有限搜索预算下的成功频率，并不是语义上逐步有效性的独立 verifier。这是依据所述反馈契约作出的 curator inference。

未发布的 verifier 与轨迹边界。 已核验 launcher 需要私有 extractor 和 binary judge 端点。其模型、提示词、版本、重试行为和校准均为 unknown。尽管代码可表示父子链接、token、分数和终点数据，尚未核验到公开的原始树、被拒绝分支或从叶节点到训练 trace 的记录；无法从提示—答案行中恢复这些信息以重建或审计。

预算与归因。 论文称，在没有专用树推理优化时，EPTree 至少需要两轮生成，速度约为 multi-chain sampling 的一半。其入选设定使用 30 个叶节点和 480 的训练 batch，而 ChainRL 为 16 和 256。因此，生成 token 预算匹配的比较不能分离过程奖励与额外搜索路径或优化计算的作用。

数据治理。 论文点名 MATH-train 和 NuminaMath，但没有提供输入 JSONL 的发布清单、来源比例、去污染分析、基准重叠分析、逐行划分或上游权利映射。代码的 Apache-2.0 并不能解决数据集或生成轨迹的复用权利问题。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, TreeRL is a useful recipe for experiments in which the record must preserve more than a final answer. A reproduction or comparison should log prompt provenance; initial chains; fork scores and positions; parent links; all leaves; terminal extraction and verdict metadata; selected and rejected traces; token and wall-clock budgets; and the exact policy, verifier, and launcher revisions.

It can support a controlled comparison of independent-sampling RLVR against tree-derived process supervision, or an ablation of entropy selection, branch count, expansion rounds, and reward reweighting. The appropriate reuse class is recipe/audit reference and controlled experimental baseline, not direct training-data reuse: train_30k.jsonl may be used as input only after source provenance, empty-record handling, split semantics, decontamination, and rights are independently audited.

The Card also provides an audit checklist: ask whether an observed gain comes from a better branch selector, a stronger terminal service, more generated leaves, more optimization traces, or a process-credit formula. Do not use benchmark performance as a substitute for releasing and validating the underlying trace records.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 而言，TreeRL 是一项有用配方，适用于记录不能只保留最终答案的实验。复现或比较应记录提示来源、初始链、分叉分数与位置、父子链接、全部叶节点、终点提取和判定元数据、入选与被拒绝 trace、token 与墙钟预算，以及策略、verifier 和 launcher 的确切版本。

它可用于受控比较独立采样 RLVR 与树派生过程监督，或消融熵选择、分支数量、扩展轮数和奖励重加权。适当的复用类别是配方/审计参考和受控实验基线，而不是直接训练数据复用：只有在独立审计来源、空记录处理、划分语义、去污染和权利后，train_30k.jsonl 才可作为输入使用。

本卡还给出审计清单：观察到的增益究竟来自更好的分支选择器、更强的终点服务、更多生成叶节点、更多优化 trace，还是过程归因公式？不能用基准性能代替对底层轨迹记录的发布和验证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.1 and 3.2 together: EPTree's branch structure is the source of both exploration and the process-reward calculation.
  • Use Appendix Table 4 and Table 3 before interpreting gains; compare 30 leaves/480 training batch with 16 leaves/256 rather than calling the setup fully compute-matched.
  • Inspect scripts/treerl-qw14b.sh, tree_node.py, and remote_reward.py before treating a final-answer reward as reproducible.
  • Keep the released prompt-answer input file distinct from the missing runtime trees, rejected branches, and selection ledger.
  • Treat source mapping, decontamination, service versions, and trace release as reuse gates.

• 应将第 3.1 与 3.2 节一起阅读：EPTree 的分支结构既是探索来源，也是过程奖励计算的来源。
  • 在解释增益前先看附录表 4 和表 3；应比较 30 个叶节点/480 训练 batch 与 16 个叶节点/256，而不要把该设定称作完全计算匹配。
  • 在把最终答案奖励视为可复现之前，检查 scripts/treerl-qw14b.sh、tree_node.py 和 remote_reward.py。
  • 将已发布的提示—答案输入文件与缺失的运行时树、被拒绝分支和选择账本严格区分。
  • 把来源映射、去污染、服务版本和轨迹发布视为复用门槛。

value_zh.html: 当前 on-policy 策略生成 EPTree 响应分支。论文评测 Qwen-2.5-14B、GLM4-9B 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-2.5-7B 系列；所检查启动器目标为 qwen-14b-2.5-instruct。

value.html: EPTree performs batched on-policy generation, token-uncertainty-driven forking, leaf checking, tree-value propagation, and policy-gradient updates. The code contains serializable token IDs, token strings, log probabilities, masks, finish reasons, and parent indices, but no public runtime-tree corpus was verified.

value_zh.html: EPTree 执行批量 on-policy 生成、token 不确定性驱动的分叉、叶检查、树价值传播与策略梯度更新。代码含可序列化 token IDs、token 字符串、对数概率、masks、结束原因与父索引，但未核验公开运行时树语料。

value.html: In the paper, a leaf receives rule-based reward 1 for a correct final answer and 0 otherwise. A node value is the proportion of correct descendant leaves; TreeRL combines global and local advantages and divides repeated non-leaf rewards by the square root of selected descendant traces. The public launcher calls private answer-extractor and binary-judge endpoints, so their deployed model revisions, prompts, normalization, and failure behavior are unknown.

value_zh.html: 论文中，叶对正确最终答案获得基于规则的奖励 1，否则为 0。节点值是正确后代叶的比例；TreeRL 结合全局与局部优势，并将重复的非叶奖励除以所选后代轨迹数的平方根。公开启动器调用私有答案提取器与二元判定端点，因此其部署模型修订、提示、归一化与失败行为未知。

value.html: The paper defines correctness at the final answer. The checked launcher sends prompt, response, and label to remote services and expects a binary outcome. Exact answer extraction and equivalence semantics are not reproducible from the public artifact alone.

value_zh.html: 论文在最终答案处定义正确性。所检查启动器将 prompt、response 与 label 发送到远程服务并期望二元结果。仅凭公开产物无法复现精确答案提取与等价语义。

value.html: Paper experiments report Qwen-2.5-14B, GLM4-9B, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-2.5-7B. The checked launcher names qwen-14b-2.5-instruct. No TreeRL checkpoint release was verified.

value_zh.html: 论文实验报告 Qwen-2.5-14B、GLM4-9B 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-2.5-7B。所检查启动器命名 qwen-14b-2.5-instruct。未核验 TreeRL checkpoint 发布。

value.html: EPTree first samples M complete chains, selects high-uncertainty eligible token positions, forks T continuations from the top-N positions, and repeats expansion for L rounds.

value_zh.html: EPTree 先采样 M 条完整链，选择高不确定性合格 token 位置，从 top-N 位置分叉 T 条延续，并重复扩展 L 轮。

value.html: The main RL setting is (M,N,L,T)=(6,2,1,2), yielding 30 leaves per prompt; it is compared with 16 independent responses at similar generation-token budget. Each update uses 16 prompts, giving reported training batch sizes of 480 for TreeRL and 256 for ChainRL.

value_zh.html: 主 RL 设置为 (M,N,L,T)=(6,2,1,2)，每个提示产生 30 个叶；与相近生成-token 预算下的 16 条独立响应对比。每次更新使用 16 个提示，所报训练 batch sizes 为 TreeRL 的 480 与 ChainRL 的 256。

value.html: The paper's main EPTree setting has 30 leaves per prompt. The checked launcher sets NUM_TRACE=16 and num_trace_per_sample=16; the exact mapping from leaves to optimization traces needs runtime-log inspection.

value_zh.html: 论文的主 EPTree 设置为每个提示 30 个叶。所检查启动器设置 NUM_TRACE=16 与 num_trace_per_sample=16；从叶到优化轨迹的精确映射需检查运行时日志。

value.html: Tokens near sequence ends are masked before forking. Repeated non-leaf steps are downweighted by the square root of selected descendant traces. The paper does not disclose a prompt-selection manifest or a released tree-retention policy.

value_zh.html: 分叉前屏蔽靠近序列末尾的 tokens。重复的非叶步骤按所选后代轨迹数的平方根降权。论文未披露提示选择清单或已发布的树保留策略。

value.html: The paper reports top-p 0.95 and maximum sequence length 8192. On Omni-MATH-500, its selected (6,2,1,2) setting reports 30 leaves, 56.9 PassRate, and 22,268 generation tokens, versus multi-16 at 52.4 and 19,858.

value_zh.html: 论文报告 top-p 0.95 与最大序列长度 8192。在 Omni-MATH-500 上，其所选 (6,2,1,2) 设置报告 30 个叶、56.9 PassRate 与 22,268 个生成 tokens，对比 multi-16 的 52.4 与 19,858。

value.html: Policy-gradient RL consumes tree-derived process rewards. The paper reports learning rate 1.5e-6 and KL coefficient 1e-4; the checked launcher uses the same learning rate but KL=0.0. Its exact relation to the reported runs is unknown.

value_zh.html: 策略梯度 RL 消费由树导出的过程奖励。论文报告学习率 1.5e-6 与 KL 系数 1e-4；所检查启动器使用相同学习率但 KL=0.0。其与所报告运行的确切关系未知。

value.html: The paper names MATH-train and NuminaMath. The released JSONL is a 10,562,582 byte file in the official repository, but a row-level source manifest and upstream-license mapping were not verified.

value_zh.html: 论文点名 MATH-train 与 NuminaMath。已发布 JSONL 是官方仓库中一个 10,562,582 字节的文件，但未核验行级来源清单与上游许可映射。

value.html: The paper says a subset of the named public training data is sampled for RL. Exact item identifiers, source proportions, split policy, and relationship between the experimental subset and train_30k.jsonl are unknown.

value_zh.html: 论文称从具名公开训练数据中采样一个子集用于 RL。精确条目标识符、来源比例、划分策略，以及实验子集与 train_30k.jsonl 的关系未知。

items: Final-answer correctness does not establish that every intermediate reasoning step is valid.
A remote extractor or binary judge can introduce false positives, false negatives, or version drift; its implementation is not released.
The paper reports EPTree needs at least two generation rounds and is approximately twice as slow as multi-chain sampling without tree-specific inference optimization.
Changing search budget changes both sampled traces and tree-derived credit, so gains cannot be attributed to process rewards alone.
Source provenance, decontamination, benchmark overlap, and data-specific licensing are not disclosed.
Raw trees, rejected branches, and leaf-to-training-trace selection are absent, limiting lineage and failure audits.
最终答案正确性并不确立每一步中间推理都有效。
远程提取器或二元判定器可能引入假阳性、假阴性或版本漂移；其实现未发布。
论文报告 EPTree 至少需要两轮生成，且在无树特定推断优化时约比多链采样慢两倍。
改变搜索预算会同时改变采样轨迹与由树导出的信用分配，因此增益不能仅归因于过程奖励。
来源出处、去污染、基准重叠与数据特定许可未披露。
原始树、被拒分支与叶到训练轨迹选择缺失，限制谱系与失败审计。

value.html: The official repository declares Apache-2.0 for code. Licensing and reuse conditions for upstream prompt-answer records, train_30k.jsonl, and generated runtime trees are unknown.

value_zh.html: 官方仓库声明代码为 Apache-2.0。上游提示-答案记录、train_30k.jsonl 与生成的运行时树的许可与复用条件未知。

value.html: Public prompt-answer input -> current-policy EPTree -> remote terminal checking -> descendant correctness values -> global/local step advantages and square-root reweighting -> selected optimization traces -> updated policy. The raw tree, leaf-to-trace selection record, and rejected branches are not publicly verified.
